metadata.axes: ICRS (treated as J2000 equatorial axes at this display precision)
metadata.selection: Union of V<7 and parallax>40mas; merge every original app star and constellation anchor at runtime
metadata.distancePolicy: 1000/parallaxMas pc only if positive parallax and formal relative error<=20%; other depths explicitly illustrative
metadata.radialVelocityPolicy: Use only quality A/B with a finite reported error below999km/s; otherwise radial component assumed zero and flagged
metadata.retainedAttempt: Initial bright.tsv and nearby.tsv queries used original ReadMe names RAdeg/DEdeg, silently omitted by VizieR. They are preserved but unused; corrected RAJ2000/DEJ2000 responses supply coordinates at actual epochJ1991.25.
